title: Creation & Covenant
description: A first trail through the opening chapters of Genesis: how the world began, what it means to be made in God's image, and his promise to Noah.

waypoints.title: In the Beginning
waypoints.body: Before there was anything else, there was God. In six days he spoke the world into being — light, sky, land, plants, sun and moon and stars, sea creatures and birds, animals, and finally people — and he called it very good.

waypoints.title: Made in His Image
waypoints.body: Draw or write about your favorite part of creation. Why do you think God made people different from the animals and plants?

waypoints.title: Spot the Creator
waypoints.body: This week, find something in nature that reminds you God is the Creator, and tell a family member about it. Write what you found in the journal.
